text.content:
Classification: Low Clan

The Gangrel shun cities, making their homes among the wild peoples and places of the world — Tartars, Tuaregs, Bedouins, and northern barbarian tribes. Clan legend holds they descend not from Caine but from the war-goddess Ennoia, cursed alongside her chosen children by her own decree that they depend on the blood of others, after being betrayed by two of her warriors at the urging of the trickster god Churka. Gangrel see civilization as a trap of Churka's making and value bravery, honor, martial prowess, survival skill, and knowledge of the land above all.

Disciplines: Animalism, Fortitude, Protean

Advantage: Gangrel begin with two free Ability Traits of Animal Ken, Brawl or Survival. Their familiarity with the wild — including experience evading and observing Lupines — makes them more likely to survive such encounters, and most princes let them come and go freely rather than try to enforce restrictions on their movement.

Disadvantage: When a Gangrel frenzies, the inner Beast forces a physical transformation matching her animal nature (clawed feet, cat-like eyes, etc., chosen by the player), granting a new Negative Social Trait of Bestial, Fiend, or Repugnant that can never be bought off without supernatural assistance. No more than five such Negative Traits may be accumulated.

Organization: Largely solitary; sires often leave childer to fend for themselves to test their mettle. Most spend long stretches alone punctuated by brief periods among other vampires.

Suggested Viae: Beast is most common, but Gangrel walk every major road.
